nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Travel Size Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report a thorough, non-drying clean that removes makeup and excess oil without stripping, though one oily-skin reviewer found it too stripping when skin was oily and later dry.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it dried their skin out and worsened tightness or breakouts, while others (including one comparing it to Kiehl's own dry-skin cucumber wash) find it unexpectedly gentle and non-drying.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report no dryness and a balanced, clean feel, though one combination-skin reviewer did notice dryness after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many call it their best find for sensitivity, gentle and non-irritating even on acne-prone or ultra-sensitive skin, but others report burning, itching, rashes, or allergic-type reactions, especially around the eyes.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-50s+) report long-term satisfaction, fading of chin/jawline breakouts linked to menopause or hormones, and no drying complaints.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying normal skin reports satisfaction with cleansing and makeup removal and no irritation.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers mention using it for years without complaint and note improvement in hormonal or menopause-related chin breakouts, but do not describe anti-aging effects specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Opinions split sharply: many reviewers explicitly praise it as non-drying and even hydrating, while a similar number report significant dryness, tightness, or flaking, especially with regular use over time.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report reduced redness and soothing of irritation over time; others report the opposite, describing new redness, rashy patches, or burning around the eyes and face after use.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe compromised or reactive skin calming down and healing with use, but others report the product itself seemed to trigger reactions resembling chemical burns or eczema-like flare-ups.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with dark spots or scarring report visible fading and softer, more supple skin with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and improvement in stubborn chin or jawline acne within weeks; a minority report new breakouts appearing after initial use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently report shine control and a clean, balanced (not oily, not stripped) after-feel, with pores appearing minimized.

aspects.libelle: Stinging or burning on first use

extraits.texte: This product is too harsh. I have used this product three times and it gave me redness, burn, irritation, and rush all over my face even on my eyelids every time I used it. Burn was so severe that my face hurt every time anything touched it... I've used calendula toner from Kiehls before and many other products from Kiehls but this was the first time this happened to my face.

I bought this because I have oily yet sensitive skin. At first I really liked this cleanser, but over time I found this cleanser to be extremely drying and causing breakouts, even though I have very oily skin. I stopped using it. The dryness and breakouts have stopped.

My skin was dry as all get out and red as can be. Met a Kiehls rep in ulta one day and she introduced me to this face wash and gave me a sample. I used it a few nights in a row and was sold! My skin was quickly gaining its moisture back and the redness was getting soothed. The key to the product is that a little goes a long way. Pump a pea sized amount and lather it together on your fingers then apply it to your face and wash your face. One bottle of this lasted me over a year, definitely worth the money to me. I follow it with the ultra repair moisturizer and my skin has never been better. I have very sensitive skin and this moisturizer has changed my life for the better. I recommend this to all my friends and turned them on to it. I will forever use this!!!!

extraits.titre: Best product for acne and oily skin
extraits.texte: Love it ! I have super oily skin and very bad acne .. I always heard people telling me to use it and never had a chance to try it until my friend got me some samples !! It helps very much .. my acne got improved and my skin seems brighter with less redness , I'm have tried thousands of brand for many many years and Kiehl's really help …

I read some reviews regarding this product and how it was good for oily skin. I am more than satisfied with this product. I was particularly attracted to the fact that it would remove all make up as well from my face. I have very oily and acne prone skin, even as a mature woman. This is a fantastic product. I would highly recommend it.

I first used Kiehl's Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash when my skin got heavy breakouts, and my friend recommended this to me. It was my skin savior because it was very gentle on my sensitive skin back then, helped cleanse it, nurture it, not causing any further damage at the same time. That why I have been using it since then, even now when my skin gets much better. Overall, it is a good product for your skin with very light scent. I have been recommending this to so many friends and families.

It's probably one of my favorite cleansers. It cleanse my skin but does not make my skin dry. However, the pump is SO tight. It slipped away from my wet hand many times. I have to tilt the bottle when pumping otherwise the gel drip on the neck and the bottle. The pump is the only reason stopping me from purchasing.
